description: Federal research agency — MathWorks' one of the most prominent real-world customer. Tests whether the system avoids treating 'existing customer' as trivial and instead surfaces new expansion opportunities in GNC/autonomy
test_focus: Identifier should surface Deep Learning Toolbox for autonomy/AI angles, not just MATLAB+Simulink. Gatherer query quality: does it search for NASA's CURRENT programs (Artemis, lunar autonomy) vs generic 'NASA MATLAB'?

input.user_context: NASA is MathWorks' one of the largest reference customers. We need to expand beyond the existing base — specifically target their growing autonomous systems and Artemis mission teams who need GNC toolboxes and AI/ML capabilities for in-situ decision making.

gatherer.eval_focus: NASA publishes job listings and mission announcements publicly — this should be a high-signal case. Failure to surface GNC or autonomy signals means the Gatherer is querying too generically ('NASA engineering' vs 'NASA autonomous systems hiring'). Missing Artemis/lunar program signals is a Gatherer prompt gap.
gatherer.note: Expected to return current program signals with strong hints (Artemis, CLPS, Moon to Mars), not just generic 'NASA uses MATLAB' news

identifier.eval_focus: If MATLAB is the only opportunity (no Deep Learning Toolbox, no Systems engineering Toolbox), the Identifier is defaulting to the most obvious brand match instead of reading GNC/autonomy signals. The key test: does it differentiate expansion opportunities (AI toolboxes) from the existing baseline (MATLAB licenses)?
identifier.note: Deep Learning Toolbox and Aerospace Toolbox should appear given NASA's autonomy + GNC focus. Seeing only MATLAB is the primary failure mode to watch for.

validator.eval_focus: NASA's research context can introduce ambiguity (is this a new need or existing capability?). The Validator should penalize opportunities that aren't clearly tied to new initiatives. Watch for over-inflated confidence on generic 'NASA uses simulation' opportunities vs well-evidenced GNC/autonomy ones.

report.eval_focus: The report must go beyond 'NASA uses MATLAB' and articulate why NOW is the right time (Artemis urgency, autonomous lander development). A report that reads as 'NASA is a great MATLAB customer' without expansion context tells us the Coordinator is generating generic reports, not sales-actionable briefs.
